summary: Latham Group's subsidiary borrower entered a new senior secured credit agreement on August 20, 2026, comprising a $75 million multicurrency revolver and a $300 million term loan, replacing a 2022 facility. Proceeds repaid and terminated the prior credit agreement. The revolver matures August 20, 2031, and pricing ranges from SOFR/CORRA/EURIBOR/BBSY plus 3.25%-3.50%, or alternate base/Canadian prime plus 2.25%-2.50%, tied to first-lien net leverage. Jefferies Finance is administrative agent. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation; watch leverage and rate exposure.
